CustomField.description: System will apply the following color coding based on the age of the task- Green: From creation up to the task's due date. Amber: The day after the task's due date. Red: Starting two days after the due date and beyond.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,'Completed'), ISPICKVAL(Status,'Cancelled') ), IMAGE("/resource/BSF_Static_Resources", "Grey", 25, 92), IF( ISNULL(ActivityDate), '', IF( ActivityDate >= TODAY(), IMAGE("/resource/sked_HLT_Dist/images/Green.png", "Green", 25, 92), CASE( MOD( TODAY() - DATE(1900,1,1), 7 ), 6, IF( (TODAY() - ActivityDate - 1) > 2, IMAGE("/resource/sked_HLT_Dist/images/Red.png", "Red", 25, 92), IMAGE("/resource/sked_HLT_Dist/images/Amber.png", "Amber", 25, 92) ), 0, IF( (TODAY() - ActivityDate - 2) > 2, IMAGE("/resource/sked_HLT_Dist/images/Red.png", "Red", 25, 92), IMAGE("/resource/sked_HLT_Dist/images/Amber.png", "Amber", 25, 92) ), 1, IF( (TODAY() - ActivityDate - 2) > 2, IMAGE("/resource/sked_HLT_Dist/images/Red.png", "Red", 25, 92), IMAGE("/resource/sked_HLT_Dist/images/Amber.png", "Amber", 25, 92) ), IF( (TODAY() - ActivityDate) > 2, IMAGE("/resource/sked_HLT_Dist/images/Red.png", "Red", 25, 92), IMAGE("/resource/sked_HLT_Dist/images/Amber.png", "Amber", 25, 92) ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Color Code
